receipts.sql: SELECT i.*, e.from_domain, e.subject FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.emails e ON e.email_id = i.email_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0003'

SELECT v.vendor_id, v.name, v.lei AS registry_id, v.bank_since, v.country, v.lei AS lei_on_file, v.gleif_legal_name AS gleif_name, v.gleif_entity_status AS entity_status, v.gleif_registration_status AS registration_status, (SELECT count(*) FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.payments p WHERE p.vendor_id = v.vendor_id) AS paid_count FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.vendors v JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i ON i.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0003'

SELECT i.iban_hash AS inv_hash, i.iban_last4 AS inv_last4, v.iban_hash AS master_hash, v.iban_last4 AS master_last4, v.bank_since FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.vendors v ON v.vendor_id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0003'

SELECT b.request_id, b.new_iban_hash, b.new_iban_last4, b.requested_at, b.channel, b.verified_by FROM lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.bank_change_requests b JOIN lightning.metastore.humankey.northwind.invoices i ON i.vendor_id = b.vendor_id WHERE i.invoice_id = 'INV0003' ORDER BY b.requested_at
